name: SnapFire
shortDescription: Alarm that fires darts at you: OpenCV face detection on a Raspberry Pi aims a launcher built from salvaged Roomba motors.
description:
SnapFire is an automatic dart launcher that wakes a sleeping person: OpenCV detects their face, and the launcher aims and fires. It uses an automatic tension-loading system, a Raspberry Pi, and salvaged Roomba motors for pan and tilt.

Won the **Wolfram Alpha Award** and **Staff Picks** at AliceHacks (November 2023).
award: Wolfram Alpha Award + Staff Picks, AliceHacks
